name: BlinklinkFeed
summary: Blinklink server-driven short-form video feed SDK for iOS.
description:
Short-form video feeds rendered natively: embeddable video feeds
(carousel / 3D carousel / grid) and a vertical video feed with a
shorts player — likes, share links, CTAs, offline caching, and
built-in analytics. Layouts and settings update from the Blinklink
marketer app with no app release.
